details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Infinite loop in EC key generation with a group order of 1
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-107496.patch: reject a group order of 1 or less
       in ec_key_simple_generate_key() in crypto/ec/ec_key.c, add a regression
       test to test/ectest.c
     - CVE-2026-107496
   * SECURITY UPDATE: Use-after-free in PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio() with a
     caller-supplied stack
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-107493.patch: on failure pop and free only the
       entries added by this call in crypto/pem/pem_info.c, add regression
       tests to test/x509_check_cert_pkey_test.c
     - CVE-2026-107493
   * SECURITY UPDATE: NULL pointer dereference in DANE TLSA checks
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-84786.patch: check the trust store copy of a
       self-signed leaf against DANE-TA(2) SPKI(1) Full(0) keys instead of
       dereferencing a NULL chain entry in check_dane_pkeys() in
       crypto/x509/x509_vfy.c, add a regression test to test/danetest.c
     - CVE-2026-84786
